summary: Added deterministic offline manual snapshot import for the manual paper workspace inbox. The importer discovers source files or directories, classifies importable and bad inputs, computes stable digests, assigns canonical inbox names, remains read-only by default, writes inbox files only with --write-inbox, and writes an import manifest only with --out-manifest.

import_summary.default_read_only_preserved: verified: default command writes no inbox files and no manifest
import_summary.importable_snapshots: 2 snapshots are importable: series_snapshot_004 and series_snapshot_005
import_summary.snapshots_imported_to_temp_workspace: verified: --write-inbox writes 004_series_snapshot_004.json and 005_series_snapshot_005.json only in a copied temp workspace
import_summary.manifest_write_tested: verified: --out-manifest writes expected deterministic manifest JSON
import_summary.canonical_fixture_mutation_avoided: verified by byte snapshot tests and post-check of canonical inbox file names

notes: No files under Codex copy roots were edited.
The canonical fixture workspace remained read-only during import tests; write behavior was tested against temporary workspace copies.
The canonical root is not a Git repository in this environment, so git status/diff were unavailable.
